facts.business: Rana Sugars Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of sugar, distillery products (ethanol), and cogeneration of power across its plants in Punjab and Uttar Pradesh.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: 20,500 TCD (Tonnes of Cane Crushed per day) across three units
335 KLPD (Kilolitres per day) across two units
102 MW installed capacity across three units

key_risks: Commodity price risk of raw materials (sugarcane) - 10% change in year-end price affects profit before tax by Rs 12,765.92 lakhs
Inventory valuation risk of finished goods, by-products and work in progress (carrying value Rs 389.66 crores as on March 31, 2026)
Regulatory risk - Purchase tax demands from Punjab government totaling Rs 1,047.22 lakhs for FY 2005-06 to 2013-14
Legal risk - ED seizure of immovable properties worth Rs 22.02 crore under FEMA, appeal pending before Appellate Tribunal
